title: ShifCon: Enhancing Non-Dominant Language Capabilities with a Shift-based Multilingual Contrastive Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance disparities between dominant (high-resource) and non-dominant (low-resource) languages across various multilingual generation and classification benchmarks (MGSM, FLORES, XCOPA, XNLI, XStoryCloze), as well as analyzing internal representation alignment using Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) and a Riemannian subspace distance metric.
